title: Beaver Lamp Pro
descriptionHtml:
No more darkness when you're working – keep both hands free

You know how it is. You're leaning over the engine bay, or crawling down into the boat to fix something that has to be done. The light isn't enough. The flashlight is in the wrong place. The phone dies.

It shouldn't be like this.

With the right headlamp you work efficiently, see every detail and skip the frustration. No hassle. Just clear, steady light exactly where you need it.

The solution – powerful, light and built to be used

This rechargeable headlamp gives you wide 270° work lighting and a focused spotlight that reaches up to 200 meters.

Whether you:

  • Work on the car in the garage

  • Fix the wiring or engine on the boat

  • Tinker late in the evening

  • Work in tight spaces

  • Are out camping or fishing

… you have the right light, right away.

It weighs just 100 grams and sits comfortably thanks to soft silicone and an adjustable strap. You hardly notice you're wearing it.

And yes, you can switch it on and off by waving your hand in front of the lamp. Perfect when your hands are dirty.

Features & Specifications

Brightness:

  • 1500 lumens total

  • 1000 lm from 3 COB LEDs (wide 270° lighting)

  • 500 lm from XPE spotlight (up to 200 m range)

5 light modes:

  • COB – full power

  • COB – medium

  • XPE – full power

  • XPE – medium

  • COB + XPE – flash mode

Battery & charging:

  • Built-in 2200 mAh lithium battery (3.7V)

  • 3–4 hours at full power

  • Up to 6 hours with normal use

  • Fast charging via USB-C (2.5–3 hours)

  • Red indicator while charging

  • Flashes red when battery is low

  • Green light when fully charged

Other:

  • Motion sensor (on/off with a hand wave approx. 10 cm away)

  • IP45 – withstands rain and moisture

  • Material: Flexible silicone

  • Color: Black

  • Adjustable size – fits everyone

  • USB-C cable included

For those who want to work smarter

This is not a toy. It's a tool.

With the right light you work faster, safer and more carefully. Less irritation. Better results.

Perfect to keep in the car, the boat, the toolbox or the garage – always ready when you need it.

Change your mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
